name: Julia Jana
languages: Sacred Language of the Janus Cult

attacks.label: Hastile Optio
attacks.note: Knobbed staff, mark of the Optio. Can be used as quarterstaff (1d6 versatile 1d8).

attacks.label: Gladius ATK
attacks.note: Versatile (1d10). Standard legionary sword.

attacks.label: Pugio ATK
attacks.note: Finesse, light, thrown 20/60ft.

attacks.label: Toll the Dead
attacks.on_fail: 1d12 necrotic instead if target is missing any HP

attacks.label: Guiding Bolt
attacks.note: Range 120ft. On hit: next attack vs target has advantage.

attacks.label: Healing Word
attacks.note: BA, 60ft range, verbal only. +1d4 per slot above 1st.

attacks.label: Moonbeam
attacks.note: Con save or half. 5ft cylinder, 40ft tall, 60ft range. Concentration 1min. Repeat save when enters or starts turn in beam.

attacks.label: Faerie Fire
attacks.note: DEX save or outlined in light. Attacks vs outlined creatures have advantage. 20ft cube, 60ft range. Concentration 1min.

attacks.label: Sleep
attacks.note: Affects creatures by HP (lowest first). 90ft range. 1min. +2d8 per slot above 1st.

attacks.label: Healing Hands
attacks.note: 1/LR. Touch.

attacks.label: Twilight Sanctuary
attacks.note: CD. 30ft aura 1min (conc). Allies ending turn in aura: choose this+WisMod temp HP OR end charmed/frightened.

attacks.label: Bless
attacks.note: Conc 1min. Up to 3 willing creatures add this die to attack rolls and saving throws. L1.

attacks.label: Aid
attacks.note: 3 creatures gain +5 max and current HP for 8hr. L2. +5 per slot above 2nd.

attacks.label: Radiant Soul
attacks.note: BA. Grow wings, fly speed = walk speed, 1min. First attack each turn deals +3 radiant. 1/LR.

attacks.label: Heavy Pilum
attacks.note: Thrown 30/60ft. On hit: target shield unusable until repaired (1hr). Single-use per pilum (bends on impact). Retrieve DC14 Athletics.

attacks.label: Light Pilum
attacks.note: Thrown 20/40ft. +1d4 piercing vs unshielded target. Retrievable. Enemy can throw it back as BA.

attacks.label: Guidance
attacks.note: Touch. Concentration 1min. Target adds this roll to one ability check of their choice.

attacks.label: Light
attacks.note: Touch. 1hr. Object sheds bright light 20ft, dim light 20ft further. Hostile creature: DEX save to avoid.

attacks.label: Spare the Dying
attacks.note: Touch. Stabilizes a creature at 0 HP. No action cost variant (TCoE: can target within 15ft as BA if you have the feat).

attacks.label: See Invisibility
attacks.note: Self. 1hr. See invisible creatures and objects. See into Ethereal Plane. L2.

attacks.label: Silence
attacks.note: Range 120ft. 10min. 20ft radius sphere. No sound. Immunity to thunder. Verbal components impossible inside. Concentration. L2.

background_story: Roman noble, Gens Jana, lineage to god Janus. Father is Senator Gaius Janus. Last of the Jana name. One campaign then back to Rome for political career — first female quaestor, then senator. Twilight domain chosen because Janus governs transitions and thresholds; twilight is a threshold. Three servants (Primus, Secondus, Tertius) hired by father.
notes: Alignment LN. Gens Jana — lineage to god Janus. Aasimar: resistance radiant+necrotic, healing hands (1x LR 2d4), light bearer, 3 extra radiant dmg + fly 1 min (BA). Spellcasting WIS, Spell DC 13, Spell Atk +5. Cantrips: guidance, light, spare the dying, toll the dead. L1: bless, faerie fire (always prep), guiding bolt, healing word, sleep (always prep). L2: aid, moonbeam (always prep), see invisibility (always prep), silence. Feats: Adv WIS Insight vs deception/loyalty (10+ min interrogation, DM lies shown as NPC lies). Once/session reroll INT. BA move ally 60ft without reaction. Adv visual stealth in dim/dark. 3 servants: Primus, Secondus, Tertius. L4: ASI taken. +1 second-level spell slot (now 4/3).
